entries.speaker: Surprised Female Student
entries.en: It says they're looking for[n]information. I heard Principal[n]Kobayakawa put it up.

entries.speaker: Hesitant Female Student
entries.en: "Please consult the student council[n]president if you have any details."

entries.speaker: Dubious Male Student
entries.en: So we can go to her for anything?

entries.speaker: Dubious Male Student
entries.en: Why the student council president[n]though? What does she have to do[n]with Principal Kobayakawa?

entries.speaker: Surprised Female Student
entries.en: I mean, Niijima-san is his favorite.[n]Maybe that's why he asked her[n]to do it.
